sloka: एष ते नृगशापस्य विस्तरो ऽभिहितो मया ।यद्यस्ति श्रवणे श्रद्धा शृणुष्वेहापरां कथाम् ।। ७.५५.१ ॥
transliteration: eṣa te nṛgaśāpasya vistaro 'bhihito mayā ।yadyasti śravaṇe śraddhā śṛṇuṣvehāparāṁ kathām ।। 7.55.1 ॥

translations.english: I have told you this detailed account of Nṛga's curse; if you have a desire to listen, then hear another story here.
